mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, increasing present value and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 260.0 indicates accelerating inflation, triggering Fed tightening and depressing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 260.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 500000 indicate robust consumer demand, boosting earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 500000.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) with strong job growth (PAYEMS > 150000), labor market tightness increases corporate costs and reduces margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS > 150000.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO > 108.0) signals expanding manufacturing output, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 108.0.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO below 105.0 indicates industrial contraction, reducing corporate earnings and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST below 1500.0 signals weak housing activity, reducing consumer confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1500.0.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates strong labor market conditions, increasing consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%.
